title: Workplace Roleplays and Dilemmas
description: Practice professional communication, negotiating solutions, and handling realistic workplace scenarios.

cards.prompt: You need to ask your manager for an extension on an important project deadline because a supplier was delayed.
followUps: How would you explain the issue without sounding defensive?
What solution or new timeline would you propose?

cards.prompt: You receive two enticing job offers: one with higher pay but long office hours, and one with lower pay but full remote flexibility.
options: Higher pay with long office hours
Lower pay with full remote flexibility
followUps: Which offer would you accept and why?
How do you weigh work-life balance against financial growth?
Could you negotiate parts of either offer?
